DESCRIPTION

Located in a charming suburban neighborhood, this beautiful home gracefully sits on a spacious lot, offering picturesque views of the nearby rolling hills. Nestled in the peaceful heart of Pleasantville, it boasts contemporary design elements - truly exceptional! With expansive frontage on a quiet cul-de-sac and all essential utilities already in place, it is the perfect setting for your dream family home! If serene living appeals to you, this property is a must-see! Situated within the boundaries of Green Valley, this 200-acre community is managed by Heritage Developments. Currently, Green Valley is acclaimed as the most family-friendly and well-planned suburb in Ohio. A standout feature of Green Valley is its meticulous landscaping and thoughtful layout showcased throughout the entire community.
